reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about VEC controlling Tc via electron–phonon coupling and density of states in Ti–Hf–Zr–V–Cr HEAs, but no prior evidence is cited to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not establish these relationships for this uncharacterized alloy system.
premises: VEC modulates electron–phonon coupling strength in HEAs
VEC changes electronic density of states at the Fermi level in HEAs
Tc in HEAs depends primarily on VEC
Single-phase disordered solid solution can be maintained while varying Ti content
